package.description: Robustness: limits, mutated input, cleanup, RPC failures, drivers

script.name: limits
script.objective: Every configured limit holds with its own error.

script.name: fuzz
script.objective: Mutated inputs accepted or refused with a defined error; the server never dies.

script.name: cleanup
script.objective: Objects and memory released after success and after failure.

script.name: rpc_failure
script.objective: Handles scoped to their RPC server; timeouts fail cleanly.

script.name: drivers
script.objective: Untrusted files do not choose their driver.
